newsitem.title: USA: Kings Road seeks buyer for company.
newsitem.headline: Kings Road seeks buyer for company.

text.p: Kings Road Entertainment Inc said Wednesday it has begun actively seeking acquisition and merger proposals for the company.
"We don't have the capitalization necessary to produce the volume of mainstream independent films that we'd like to," said Chairman Ken Aguado in a statement.

In recent years, the company has produced and distributed low-budget action and martial arts films. Since the death of its founder four months ago it has reconsidered this business approach but believes that the best alternatives would require access to additional capital resources beyond those now available to the company.
Kings Road Entertainment was founded in 1984 as an independent production and distribution company. It's credits include "All of Me," "The Big Easy," "Kickboxer" and, most recently "The Redemption."
